page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external network-attached storage for operating system and application data. The underlying processor configuration does not expose advanced instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX512, AMX, or specialized hardware cryptography and virtualization flags.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.m1.medium is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for application servers, web serving, mid-range databases, and development environments that require predictable CPU performance without the overhead of shared-core configurations. The absence of local storage and advanced vector extensions positions this instance as a cost-efficient option for standard utility workloads that do not rely on heavy mathematical acceleration or high-speed local disk I/O.
